name: Interrupted Loop Sensing
hint: The block interrupts the checking of the condition in the [sbi]if () then[/sbi] block while being executed. It can happen that the condition occurs but your script doesn't react accordingly because it is busy doing the block.
instruction: Consider doing the condition checking in a separate (parallel) script.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching (edge v) ?> then
change (score v) by (-1)
end
play sound (Miau v) until done :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
if <touching (edge v) ?> then
change (score v) by (-1)
end
end

when green flag clicked :: #007000 //⇦  👍
forever
play sound (Miau v) until done
end
